name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathroom remodels?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathroom remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom design trends often focus on clean lines, natural materials, and smart technology. Popular elements include floating vanities for a spacious feel, large format tiles for fewer grout lines, and walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures. Freestanding tubs remain a luxurious choice. Color palettes tend towards neutrals with pops of organic textures. Smart features like motion-sensing lighting, heated floors, and digital shower controls are also gaining popularity for enhanced comfort and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern bathroom trends feature clean lines, natural materials, and smart tech. Popular elements include floating vanities, large tiles, walk-in showers, and neutral color palettes.
